name: Clip Bot
description: Takes long-form YouTube interviews and podcasts and produces 16:9 highlight clips with karaoke-style captions and a card crediting the source. Aimed at creators repurposing spoken-word footage; less relevant if you need vertical crops or are starting from raw unpublished material.
